chapter: Follow-up questions, Bird and the Ellington sidemen
title: More Hibbler stories: Billy Eckstine, the steak and George Shearing
summary: Hibbler's own stories about Eckstine walking him into walls, the missing steak, and Tyree Glenn's broken leg.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: You mentioned the Hibbler anecdote about beating his wife. Did Hibbler tell you that one himself?
Yeah.
I know Hibbler loves to tell stories.
Yes.
I just wondered if he --
About turning out all the lights?
Yeah.
(Laughter)
There's another one where he was on the Birdland tours too, you know.
Uh-huh.

So they had three male singers. One was Billy Eckstine, and the other was Joe Williams, of course, was with the band, and Sarah was with the trio, you know, and the band. And Hibbler said that Billy Eckstine would take him for a walk and walk him into different walls.
(Laughter)
There's a million Hibbler stories. I hope he gets his book out. He told me he was writing a book.
And he said how a lot of the guys, especially in Duke's band, he couldn't see to cut up a steak, and
he would ask somebody to cut up his steak for him, and the guys would eat it.
(Laughter)
Sounds right.
And he said he would put his fork down and all he heard was the plate, you know. There was no food on the plate.
Remember when Tyree Glenn had the broken leg on the road with Duke, and he was out there playing the vibes with his leg in a cast -- I think it was about 1950 or so.
Yeah, I think I remember that.

And in the band they said -- I don't know whether it was a joke or whether it was true, but they said the way Tyree broke his leg was that they were back east in Buffalo or somewhere and the streets were icy and Hibbler was about to go across the street by himself and Tyree was worried about him, and so he ran out to help Hibbler across the icy street and in the middle of the street Tyree fell down and broke his leg and Hibbler went right on across the street.
(Laughter)
I don't know whether I told this other story or not, but there was one with George Shearing --
Yeah, we have that on the tape.
Yeah, boy, that's a funny story. Because
when George found out that was Hibbler in the front seat, he jumped out of the car.
(Laughter)
